title: Specialist, Process Engineer - Oral Solid Dosage, Clinical Manufacturing

cond_0001.intro:
The Formulation, Laboratory, and Experimentation (FLEx) Center is a multi-modality (small molecule, biologics, vaccine) Drug Product development and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) clinical supply manufacturing facility.
The Process Engineer role at the Specialist level will serve as a leader in the FLEx Oral Solid Dosage GMP Clinical Manufacturing facility. This role will support formulation and process development, scale-up activities, quality investigations, change management and authoring GMP standard operating procedures and protocols in support of oral solid dosage clinical drug product operations. This individual will collaborate closely with the formulation scientists, engineers, quality representatives, and other team members to ensure the quality of the clinical supplies, the scientific rigor of the processes, and ultimately to enable the flexibility and speed of our Company's pipeline. The role reports to the Oral Solid Dosage Process Lead of the FLEx GMP facility within Pharmaceutical Operations and Clinical Supply.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related field with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience, OR Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related field with a minimum of 1 year relevant experience, OR Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related field
Familiarity with GMP and Safety compliance regulations
Ability to prepare Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and current GXP documents
Effective interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written
Excellent organizational skills to multi-task
Desire and willingness to learn, contribute and lead
Track-record of independent problem-solving
Ability to convert new drug product attributes and process needs to an executable series of steps and procedures to enable acceptable product manufacture
Preferred Requirements
Experience or interest in supporting electronic batch records and MES systems
Experience in leading and supporting quality investigations and change management
Experience with Oral Solid Dosage GMP facility
Experience with Commissioning, Qualification and Validation

The Process Engineer role at the Specialist level will work alongside colleagues in the FLEx Oral Solid Dosage GMP Clinical Manufacturing facility. This role will support formulation and process development, scale-up activities, quality investigations, change management, and authoring GMP standard operating procedures and protocols in support of oral solid dosage clinical drug product operations. This individual will collaborate closely with formulation scientists, engineers, quality representatives, and other team members to help ensure the quality of clinical supplies, the scientific rigor of the processes, and ultimately to support the flexibility and speed of the pipeline. The role reports to the Oral Solid Dosage Process Lead of the FLEx GMP facility within Pharmaceutical Operations and Clinical Supply.
cond_0099.responsibilities:
Work with formulation scientists and engineers to support formulation and process development activities
Coordinate scale-up activities alongside cross-functional team members
Collaborate on quality investigations and change management processes
Partner with quality representatives to author and maintain GMP standard operating procedures and protocols
Help ensure oral solid dosage clinical drug product operations meet quality and compliance standards
Support electronic batch records and MES systems in coordination with relevant teams
Work with colleagues to convert drug product attributes and process needs into executable steps and procedures for acceptable product manufacture
cond_0099.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience; OR Bachelor's degree in the same fields with a minimum of 1 year relevant experience; OR Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field
Familiarity with GMP and Safety compliance regulations
Ability to prepare Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and current GXP documents
Effective interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written
Excellent organizational skills to multi-task
Willingness to learn and contribute
Track record of independent problem-solving
Preferred Requirements
Experience in leading and supporting quality investigations and change management
Experience with Oral Solid Dosage GMP facility
Experience with Commissioning, Qualification, and Validation
Experience or interest in supporting electronic batch records and MES systems
Ability to convert new drug product attributes and process needs into an executable series of steps and procedures to enable acceptable product manufacture
cond_0099.values: We value creating outcomes that are useful, fair, and mindful of the people they affect. We aim to approach our work with responsibility and respect.
cond_0099.workplace_support: We foster connection and community through employee groups and inclusive workplace initiatives so people can bring their full selves to work and find support across different identities and life experiences.

The Process Engineer role at the Specialist level will serve as a leader in the FLEx Oral Solid Dosage GMP Clinical Manufacturing facility. cond_0369.intro:
The Formulation, Laboratory, and Experimentation (FLEx) Center is a multi-modality (small molecule, biologics, vaccine) Drug Product development and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) clinical supply manufacturing facility.
The Process Engineer role at the Specialist level will work alongside colleagues in the FLEx Oral Solid Dosage GMP Clinical Manufacturing facility. This role will support formulation and process development, scale-up activities, quality investigations, change management, and authoring GMP standard operating procedures and protocols in support of oral solid dosage clinical drug product operations. This individual will collaborate closely with formulation scientists, engineers, quality representatives, and other team members to help ensure the quality of clinical supplies, the scientific rigor of the processes, and ultimately to support the flexibility and speed of the pipeline. The role reports to the Oral Solid Dosage Process Lead of the FLEx GMP facility within Pharmaceutical Operations and Clinical Supply.

Work with formulation scientists and engineers to support formulation and process development activities

Help ensure oral solid dosage clinical drug product operations meet quality and compliance standards
Support electronic batch records and MES systems in coordination with relevant teams
Work with colleagues to convert drug product attributes and process needs into executable steps and procedures for acceptable product manufacture

cond_0449.intro:
The Formulation, Laboratory, and Experimentation (FLEx) Center is a multi-modality (small molecule, biologics, vaccine) Drug Product development and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) clinical supply manufacturing facility.
The Process Engineer role at the Specialist level will lead within the FLEx Oral Solid Dosage GMP Clinical Manufacturing facility. This role will drive formulation and process development, scale-up activities, quality investigations, change management, and authoring GMP standard operating procedures and protocols in support of oral solid dosage clinical drug product operations. This individual will take ownership of close collaboration with formulation scientists, engineers, quality representatives, and other team members to ensure the quality of clinical supplies, the scientific rigor of the processes, and ultimately to advance the flexibility and speed of [Company name masked]'s pipeline. The role reports to the Oral Solid Dosage Process Lead of the FLEx GMP facility within Pharmaceutical Operations and Clinical Supply.
cond_0449.responsibilities:
Lead formulation and process development activities for oral solid dosage clinical drug products.
Execute scale-up activities and drive them to completion.
Own quality investigations and change management processes.
Author and maintain GMP standard operating procedures and protocols.
Direct collaboration with formulation scientists, engineers, and quality representatives to ensure product quality and scientific rigor.
Ensure compliance with GMP and Safety regulations.
Manage and support electronic batch records and MES systems.
Convert new drug product attributes and process needs into executable procedures to enable acceptable product manufacture.
Lead Commissioning, Qualification, and Validation activities.

Track-record of independent problem-solving.

Experience with Commissioning, Qualification and Validation.

The Formulation, Laboratory, and Experimentation (FLEx) Center is a multi-modality (small molecule, biologics, vaccine) Drug Product development and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) clinical supply manufacturing facility.
The Process Engineer role at the Specialist level will serve as a leader in the FLEx Oral Solid Dosage GMP Clinical Manufacturing facility. This role will support formulation and process development, scale-up activities, quality investigations, change management and authoring GMP standard operating procedures and protocols in support of oral solid dosage clinical drug product operations. This individual will collaborate closely with the formulation scientists, engineers, quality representatives, and other team members to ensure the quality of the clinical supplies, the scientific rigor of the processes, and ultimately to enable the flexibility and speed of our pipeline. The role reports to the Oral Solid Dosage Process Lead of the FLEx GMP facility within Pharmaceutical Operations and Clinical Supply. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of oral solid dosage processes and GMP manufacturing requirements.

Familiarity with GMP and Safety compliance regulations.
Ability to prepare Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and current GXP documents.
Effective interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written.
Excellent organizational skills to multi-task.
Desire and willingness to learn, contribute and lead.
Track-record of independent problem-solving.
